scientific_integrity: Universal formulas follow from a deductive normal form and occupancy count; finite computations independently check small cases. The automorphism count and prior subquandle classifications are not claimed as original.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns rank-one square-zero unipotent Alexander quandles on V x V over prime fields, not arbitrary affine quandles or prescribed-image retractions. A relevant automorphism paper could not be examined in full, and absolute historical priority is unproved.
title: Complete endomorphism image spectrum of square-zero unipotent Alexander quandles
